summary: At its June 3, 2026 meeting, the TTC Board directed staff to report to the July 22, 2026 Board meeting with recommendations on options to commemorate former TTC Chair Howard Moscoe and his contributions to the Toronto Transit Commission, including consideration of a commemorative naming, and further directed that staff consult with the family of Howard Moscoe and relevant local stakeholders in developing the recommendations. Mr. Moscoe, a former Chair, Vice-Chair, and Commissioner of the TTC, passed away on May 23, 2026 at the age of 86. Following a review of commemoration options, TTC staff recommend a commemorative naming: the naming of the atrium at Yorkdale Station to the Howard Moscoe Atrium – the space that will once again house Michael Hayden’s Arc en Ciel light installation. This site was selected based on its visibility, its direct connection to Mr. Moscoe’s life and work, and feasibility for naming. After the TTC removed the original Arc en Ciel installation in the 1990s, Mr. Moscoe championed its return for years and was instrumental in advancing its restoration. The reinstatement has been supported through a combination of funding sources, including contributions from the TTC and the City of Toronto, spanning both the earlier reinstatement effort and the current installation together with development funds directed through the local Councillor’s office and approved…
decided: The TTC Board: 1. Approved the naming of the atrium at Yorkdale Station as the Howard Moscoe Atrium, in recognition of his service as the first Chair of the Toronto Transit Commission of the amalgamated City of Toronto and his decades of advocacy for public transit in Toronto, including his sustained efforts to return the Arc en Ciel light installation by artist Michael Hayden to Line 1’s Yorkdale Station, in principle and subject to: a. Consultation with the family of Howard Moscoe and receipt of the family’s written consent, in accordance with the TTC’s Commemorative and Honourary Recognition Policy; and b. Consultation with the artist, Michael Hayden, regarding the association of his work with the commemoration, and confirmation that the naming and any related signage are consistent with the artist’s moral rights and with the terms of the applicable restoration agreement. 2. Delegated authority to the Chief Strategy and Customer Experience Officer to complete the consultation with the family of Howard Moscoe and with the artist, Michael Hayden, to obtain the family’s written consent and to confirm the artist’s position on the association of his work with the commemoration, and, upon completing those steps, to finalize and implement the naming; and, if the family’s consent is not obtained or the artist’s rights cannot be satisfactorily addressed, to report back to the Board…
